articles.title: Pokémon Hits 30: How a Card-Catching Game Became the World's Biggest Franchise
articles.summary: Pokémon turns 30 this year. It launched in Japan on February 27, 1996, with two games, and is now the world's most valuable media franchise. Over 50,000 fans gathered in San Francisco for the World Championships.

articles.title: New AI Conquers Stratego, a Game Where You Can't See the Enemy
articles.summary: Researchers from MIT and other universities built an AI that beat top human Stratego players — a first. The game hides piece identities, making it a tough test. The AI is cheaper to train and could help with cybersecurity and negotiations.

articles.title: Djokovic Battles Past Borges at China Open for First Win Since Wimbledon
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic beat Nuno Borges 6-3, 7-6 (7-2) at the China Open — his first win since July. The 39-year-old needed a shoulder timeout but kept his 30-match Beijing streak alive. He faces Bu Yunchaokete next.
